summary: Turkey's GDP was 1,597,293,229,287 USD in 2025, up from 870,818,016,909.84 USD in 2016, while GDP per capita rose from 10,984.3643 USD to 18,599.4421 USD over the same years. Inflation stood at 34.8812% in 2025, down from 72.3088% in 2022, and the 10-year bond yield is unavailable (null). On 2026-09-11, the exchange rate was 0.020595 USD per TRY (TRY/USD), a -0.139% change, compared with 0.128028 in 2020 and 0.025364 in 2025.
